notes.title: Small Fixes And tweaks
notes.content:
[list][*]Now you can select audio language and text language separately.[/list]
[list][*]Now you can change the character view FOV.[/list]
[list][*]In case you get dizzy with the head tilt, now you can turn it off.[/list]
[list][*]A small fix to pick between WASD / ZQSD /<AOE[/list]
[list][*]Spare part giver bug fixed[/list]
[list][*]Air vents grid pieces no longer prevent you from jumping[/list]
[list][*]Fixed some holes in the ground.[/list]
